# Python test parity map

Pytest collection is the authority for generated parametrized cases and
documentation examples. The ordinary collection produced 1456 node IDs; the separate source-module doctest collection produced 206 node IDs and is a subset of the ordinary collection.
Checkout prefixes embedded by pytest in Markdown doctest IDs are normalized
to repository-relative evidence paths.

## Defect decisions

The Java contract deliberately corrects two source-backed Python defects:

- [`Server.attached_sessions`](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/blob/c4a980b/src/libtmux/server.py#L414-L426) uses the unregistered `noeq` lookup; Java evaluates the numeric attached count as greater than zero.
- [`Session.windows`](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/blob/c4a980b/src/libtmux/session.py#L263-L281), [`Session.panes`](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/blob/c4a980b/src/libtmux/session.py#L283-L301), and [`Window.panes`](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/blob/c4a980b/src/libtmux/window.py#L382-L400) call the strict fetch path while server-wide list accessors absorb tmux failures. Every Java list-shaped compatibility accessor returns an empty immutable list on a tmux error; `isAlive`, `raiseIfDead`, and strict snapshot/query APIs preserve the distinction.

## Fixture and marker coverage

Collection includes Python unit tests, real-tmux fixtures, doctests from source,
README and documentation, example modules, pytest-plugin fixture behavior,
parametrized IDs, and version-specific IDs. The exact node IDs below are the
reconciliation keys. Each contract below is derived from the collected body,
callspec parameters, fixtures, markers, branch-local calls and assertions,
exception or warning contexts, and doctest input/output plus directives.
Mutually exclusive branches remain conditional in one row; source `+SKIP`
examples are non-execution records, not executable Java expectations.
Fixture and marker declarations remain source evidence
under [`tests/`](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/blob/c4a980b/tests) and [`pytest_plugin.py`](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/blob/c4a980b/src/libtmux/pytest_plugin.py).
